notes: All quantities in atomic units (Hartree, Bohr). Gradients are dE/dR in Hartree/Bohr.
hessians_notes: Analytic Hessian (Eh/Bohr^2, 3N x 3N, row/column 3*atom+xyz), frequencies (cm^-1, imaginary as negative), normal modes (Cartesian, = mass-weighted unit vector / sqrt(m)) and thermochemistry (thermo.thermo, Eh and Eh/K; sym_number chosen by PySCF) from PySCF at the geomeTRIC-optimised structure (same convergence as 'optimizations', fine grid for DFT). Masses are PySCF's isotope-averaged defaults. ir_intensity_km_mol is NOT a PySCF result: PySCF's dipole moments at +-ir_displacement_bohr Cartesian displacements are central-differenced and contracted with PySCF's normal modes, then converted with docs/theory.typ eq:ir-intensity.
